title: Civic Notice: The Reservoir
description: An automated Snazzie F M civic notice regarding the second water level beneath the municipal reservoir, and what it has begun returning.

lines.speaker: ad-disclaimer
lines.text: This is a test of the Snazzie F M Civic Notification System. A second water level has formed beneath the municipal reservoir. <p:0.5> It returns what residents have placed in the first.

lines.speaker: ad-disclaimer
lines.text: <p:0.3> Do not approach the reservoir between the hours it is not approachable. The schedule is posted where you last looked.

lines.speaker: ad-disclaimer
lines.text: <p:0.3> If the water is warm, it is listening. Speak only your name and your household number.

lines.speaker: ad-disclaimer
lines.text: <p:0.3> Tonight's drinking water has been pre-remembered. You will recognize the taste. <p:0.5> This concludes the test. Please remain calm.

lines.speaker: ad-ann-deep
lines.text: <p:0.5> The reservoir has always been calm. The reservoir remains. <p:0.5> And so do you.
